description: Declarative source-of-truth spec for a recursive fan-out run. Executed directly by the manager via the Workflow tool by default; compiled to a Workflow run only when orchestration_hybrid_mode is effective (see references/routing.md).

steps.note: First gates solo vs fan-out (default solo). If fan-out: mode + scopes + stop_conditions from routing.md / frontier-model.md.

steps.then: run one agent on plan.scopes[0], skip to consolidate
steps.note: Default is one agent. Multi-agent fan-out only runs when task-decompose set fan_out true on a trigger.
One agent per scope, each FORCED to return the envelope schema. Read envelopes only, never transcripts.
Anti-drift gate. A malformed envelope never enters consolidation.
Deterministic merge; conflicts preserved, coverage honest. Emits pending_verification (high-materiality keys).
Adversarial: independent skeptics prompted to refute each high-materiality finding. Refuted findings leave the trusted set.
Rubric stop signal. Complements frontier saturation — does not override a non-empty frontier.
Dedup residual frontier against seen; produce next wave or signal saturation.

steps.condition: frontier.stop_condition NOT in (size_cap_reached, depth_cap_reached) AND frontier.next_scopes is non-empty
steps.note: Hard caps stop always. Otherwise leads win: while the frontier has new scopes the run continues (the judge never cuts a non-empty frontier short). A dry frontier always stops — the judge only labels it: 'saturated' if it recommends stop, else 'frontier_exhausted' with the shortfall in residual_uncertainty. The loop never invents leads. Exercised by tests/run_scenario.py.

notes: Default is one agent (solo_gate); fan-out only on a task-decompose trigger. Every envelope and the final consolidated object carry human_review_required: true. High-materiality findings are adversarially verified before they are trusted. Stop = frontier dry AND judge-satisfied. mutate mode uses depth_cap 1 and worktree isolation per frontier-model.md / routing.md.
